Nicolaus Copernicus faced criticism from Aristotelian scholars who defended the geocentric cosmos.
Who were some of his notable critics?
Their objections were intense!
Aristotelian scholars and Thomist theologians challenged the idea that Earth moves.
Did Church authorities also oppose him?
Their resistance was formidable!
Named critics included Christopher Clavius, Robert Bellarmine, and Tycho Brahe.
Were those objections scientific, theological, or both?
That debate changed astronomy!
